query: WITH household_sizes AS (SELECT hl.region, d.head_of_household_id, COUNT(d.id) AS household_size FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON d.id = hl.id WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح' AND d.head_of_household_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(hl.region) != '' AND hl.region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hl.region, d.head_of_household_id), regional_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(household_size) AS avg_household_size FROM household_sizes GROUP BY region), national_avg AS (SELECT AVG(household_size) AS national_average FROM household_sizes), input AS (SELECT r.region AS المنطقة, ROUND(r.avg_household_size, 2) AS متوسط_عدد_أفراد_الأسرة, ROUND(n.national_average, 2) AS المتوسط_الوطني FROM regional_avg r CROSS JOIN national_avg n ORDER BY r.avg_household_size DESC) SELECT input.*, poly.wkt FROM input JOIN ESTISHRAF_LLM_KSA_Regions_Polygons poly ON input.المنطقة = poly.region
